nonPoolDecisions: One card per printed segment: three announcements (Fógra a hAon, a Dó, a Trí), three conversations each in two míreanna (An Chéad Mhír, An Dara Mír), and three news pieces (Píosa a hAon, a Dó, a Trí): 12 cards. Each printed question (45) is its own criterion at its section’s tariff, 2 marks.

The scheme prints no answer key (PDF 20 tariffs, PDF 21–24 script). Each criterion’s guidance is the printed question and its section’s tariff line, its one row the question as printed, claimed whole [0, 2]; the card note carries the fixed UNPRINTED_ANSWER sentence. Nothing is taken from the script as an answer, and no partial is inferred.
Cumas Gaeilge 10 is one award for the whole test (PDF 20); it is stated on every card and never split into a card.

Two-answer questions ("Ainmnigh dhá áit", "Luaigh dhá bhuntáiste", "Cén dá rud", "Tabhair dhá phíosa eolais", "Luaigh dhá chineál leabhar") are priced 2 as a whole by the section tariff; the scheme prints no split, so they are claimed whole.

audio.note: HTTP 200 on 2026-11-05; 39,464,427 bytes, 128 kbps, 2,466.4 s (afinfo estimate). The scheme’s script (PDF 21–24) prints the sections this paper asks about (Fógra a hAon: Údarás na Gaeltachta’s post of Oifigeach Chaitheamh Aimsire in Gaeltacht Chiarraí). No other year’s recording is used.

caveats: The aural paper is its own component before 2012 (LC001ALPA00IV, 100 marc, 4.30–5.10 on the day of Páipéar 1); its existing Atlas entries are the section numbers 1, 2 and 3 (Cuid A, B, C). The segment cards add L-A-F1 … L-C-P3 beside them.
The scheme’s PDF 20 draws every "×" with SymbolMT U+F0B4, read as "×"; the aural paper prints no symbol-font span.
2011 prints three segments in each section (Fógra/Comhrá/Píosa a Trí), where 2012–2026 print two; the questionRef grammar needs "a Trí".
review.boundaries: 12 listening segment cards (three announcements, three conversations in two míreanna each, three news pieces) carrying all 45 printed questions as separate 2-mark criteria (90); Cumas Gaeilge 10 for the whole test.

cards.questionRef: 2011 HL Cluastuiscint Cuid C · Píosa a Dó
cards.questionText: 1. Cé dó ar tugadh onóir an tseachtain seo caite? 2. Conas a tharla gur tháinig sé go dtí an Clochán Liath a chéaduair? 3. (a) Cá háit a mbíodh a chlinicí aige sa Chlochán Liath? (b) Cá bhfuil a sheomraí aige le fada anois?
taskRequirements: Listen to the official recording.
Answer every item printed on the card.

criteria.label: Ceist 3(a)
guidance: 3. (a) Cá háit a mbíodh a chlinicí aige sa Chlochán Liath?

criteria.label: Ceist 3(b)
guidance: (b) Cá bhfuil a sheomraí aige le fada anois?

cards.markingGuideNote: Each printed question is marked at its section’s published tariff (2 marks), from the 2011 SEC marking scheme. The scheme prints no answer for this part. The 2011 scheme prints each listening section’s tariff (PDF 20) and the recording’s script (PDF 21–24), but no answer key: each printed question is claimed whole at its 2 marks, and nothing is taken from the script as an answer. Scheme PDF 20: Tuiscint 90 + Cumas Gaeilge 10 = 100. The 10 marks for Irish are one award for the whole test, never inside a single card.
